KUNINGRIIGID GODOT AUTOPORT — 0.65 SKELETAL ANIMATION AND CLOSE BATTLE CAMERA RELEASE
Reason: Android reports ~56 FPS but soldiers visibly stutter, lack skeletal animation and cannot be zoomed into closely.
Validated change: PR #17, merge commit 3052d9fdca6e381f20492fdf362df56af4906dd9.
Required tests: GitHub Actions 41836847864 SUCCESS; includes battle_motion_v65,
battle_targets_v64, battle_visual_v63, battle_perf_v62, battle_demo_v61 and all
other historic Godot, source-parity, battlefield and economy regression tests.
Source GLBs inspected directly: spearman, axeman and slinger each contain skins
and real idle/walk/run/attack/hit/death glTF animations; import animation=true.
Changes: start source AnimationPlayer clips rather than root-only posing,
drive visual movement/pose every render frame, bridge short deterministic
simulation-snapshot gaps without changing the authoritative campaign state,
enable 10m close zoom, selected-soldier focus, wheel zoom, pinch and pan.
Release requested: publish validated Android Content.pck and Windows content,
launcher and engine assets from the merged 0.65 project only.
Do not publish a debug-signed APK as an automatic Android update.
Headless tests prove functionality; physical device frame rates remain to be tested.
